deleteLocal: Really delete "{name}" with {n} project? This cannot be undone. | Really delete "{name}" with {n} projects? This cannot be undone.
hideWarning: "{name}" disappears from this rail. Everything stays on the backend, and it is back at any time through "Add workspace".
leaveWarning: You are leaving "{name}". It stays for the others; you can only get back in with a new invitation.
deleteRemote: "{name}" with {n} project is deleted {forAll}. This cannot be undone. | "{name}" with {n} projects is deleted {forAll}. This cannot be undone.
managedHint: This workspace belongs to your company in WireCloud. Whether you leave it or it is deleted is decided there by the company's administrator. "Remove only here" takes it out of this rail.
managedPersonalHint: This is your personal workspace. It belongs to you alone and cannot be deleted. "Remove only here" takes it out of this rail; it is back at any time through "Add workspace".
personalHint: The personal workspace cannot be deleted — it is the one that is always there. Renaming and inviting work.
onePasswordHelper: Account UUID and sign-in address work just as well. Only needed if keys are read from 1Password.
whereIsName: Where do I find the name?
serverHelper: For your own instance, for example {example} — Vaultwarden too. {eu} is recognized.
acceptInvalidCertWarning: The connection stays encrypted, but it is no longer checked whether this server is really at the other end. Only for self-signed certificates in front of your own instance.
bitwardenMasterHint: The master password is asked for on first access and not stored.
